description: Construct a shortest signed-reversal sorting sequence by bounded distance-decreasing self-reduction.

source.title: Sorting Signed Permutations by Reversal (Reversal Sequence)
source.algorithm_attribution: Tannier-Sagot O(n^4) shortest-reversal-sequence self-reduction; bounded exact BFS supplies reversal distances.

input.permutation_values: exactly one of +i or -i for each i in 1..n

output.encoding: [move_count, left_1, right_1, ..., left_d, right_d]; intervals are one-based inclusive

workspace.meaning: Visited predecessor table, BFS queue, move labels, and staged output for at most 3840 signed permutations.

contract.reversal: Reverse the selected inclusive interval and negate every element in it.
contract.self_reduction: At each step choose a reversal reducing exact reversal distance by one.
contract.tie_rule: Choose the smallest (left,right) pair in lexicographic order.
contract.bounded_distance_method: Exact BFS over the complete signed-permutation graph; no O(n^4) performance claim.
contract.error_results: Malformed input returns -1. Null output or insufficient capacity returns -2 without writes.

oracle_method: The package oracle performs BFS from the input and reconstructs one shortest path. The independent verifier computes all reversal distances from identity, then greedily takes the first distance-decreasing interval.
